Yes. We've had issues in the past where one level of inheritance works fine, but things break down with multiple.

@crisbeto  OK, I get your point. If you don't mind, I will add  more test later. But now I need to fix the  
ci/circleci error, I still have no idea about it.

This is the error in your test, not the one you posted above:

```
Found the synthetic property @testAnimation. Please include either "BrowserAnimationsModule" or "NoopAnimationsModule" in your application.
```

@Zuckjet, I checked CI errors and it looks like there is a couple things you can try:

- switch from `BrowserAnimationsModule` to `NoopAnimationsModule` - that should help avoid  the error that you mentioned (`The selector "root-ng-internal-isolated-122" didn't match any elements`)
- the issue that @crisbeto mentioned (`Found the synthetic property @testAnimation. Please include either "BrowserAnimationsModule" or "NoopAnimationsModule" in your application.
`) is likely to be a View Engine behavior (or a bug) that doesn't handle animation metadata inheritance correctly. I've created a [Stackblitz demo](https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-osbmex?file=src%2Fapp%2Fhello.component.ts) that reproduces the same error. I believe this issue would be fixed by the changes in this PR for Ivy, so that particular test case can be wrapped into `onlyInIvy(...)` block, [for example as shown here](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/core/test/acceptance/ng_module_spec.ts#L81).

Also, I think it'd be great to add more tests as @crisbeto proposed that would include multiple levels of inheritance and components with host bindings (which was mentioned in [Stackblitz demo](https://stackblitz.com/edit/ivy-ejv3ha?file=src%2Fapp%2Fhello.component.ts) attached to the original issue).

Please let us know if any additional information is required.

Thank you.

@AndrewKushnir  Thanks for offering so many detail info, it helped me a lot.
I have added more tests. If there is something I should change, let me know.

Hi @Zuckjet, thanks for adding extra tests.

I looked at the changes and I have a few comments:

- we should add a test with **host bindings** as it was described in original issue and demonstrated in [Stackblitz demo](https://stackblitz.com/edit/ivy-ejv3ha?file=src%2Fapp%2Fhello.component.ts). This test should work correctly with View Engine and Ivy. It'd be also great to have 3 separate tests for this: 1) with simple 1 level inheritance (Parent-Child); 2) similar test, but with multiple levels of inheritance and 3) test where parent and child components have animations with the same name

- it looks like your current fix just overrides `data` field value altogether. In case Parent and Child components have different set of animations, I'm wondering if we should merge them rather than overriding. For example, if `Parent` has animations `A` and `B` and `Child` has `B` and `C`, should the final set be `B, C` or `A, B, C` (with just one `B` present). @crisbeto could you please let us know what's the expected behavior?

Thank you.
@AndrewKushnir my understanding was that we could merge the animations so the end array looks like `[B, C, A, B]` and we could avoid de-duplcating the triggers.

> my understanding was that we could merge the animations so the end array looks like `[B, C, A, B]` and we could avoid de-duplcating the triggers.

@crisbeto thanks for advice. Since angular compilers don't de-duplcate the triggers, and two same name triggers the first will work.  I merge the animations through below functions:
https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/ef905f728f2200b7926dfdb617b8de4cd53c637e/packages/core/src/render3/features/inherit_definition_feature.ts#L188-L191

issue_context.title: Animations metadata is not inherited to sub-classed components
issue_context.body:
In Ivy, the `@Component({...})` metadata is inherited from a parent class. However, it appears that `animations` is not included.

This causes an issue when a parent class component defines animations host bindings and an animations definition, but the subclassed component only receives the host bindings.

The renderer throws an error but it is not helpful:
`Found the synthetic property @state. Please include either "BrowserAnimationsModule" or "NoopAnimationsModule" in your application.`

Reproduction: https://stackblitz.com/edit/ivy-ejv3ha?file=src/app/hello.component.ts
comments: Hi, PR #35105 with the changes to inherit animations metadata is now merged to master and will be available in 9.0.3 version of the framework. Thank you.
